changes: Added top-level proofStory config in lattice.config.json with devGateMode, reviewGateMode, and doneGateMode all set to enforce.
usage: Run normal Lattice lifecycle commands; DEV, REVIEW, and DONE now consume ProofStory gate settings from project config.
expectedOutcome: Future stories cannot silently skip ProofStory DEV, REVIEW completeness, or DONE intent equivalence checks when configured evidence is missing.
actualTranscript: Config inspection showed all three ProofStory modes set to enforce. proofstory_gate_check, proofstory_review_completeness_check, and done_intent_equivalence_check all passed in enforce mode. done_required_validate passed packages/main build and root full test suite.
outcomeDiff: No difference: actual observed behavior matches the expected enforce-mode rollout.
limitations: No runtime source code changed; this rollout enables existing gate implementations through project configuration.
pitfalls: A real second host was not available in this session, so the high-risk review assurance floor used the explicit degraded 3x1 fallback instead of pretending to have 3x2 independence.
